 A back-and-forth game went south for Mizzou in part due to a series of replay reviews that didn't go its way. The loss to No. 7 Texas could end the Tigers' pursuit of a College Football Playoff berth.

 One call changed the game for Mizzou. The Tigers finally had momentum in a deadlocked game after a 72-yard touchdown reception by Naeshaun Montgomery in the third quarter. It was flipped on its side after Texas quarterback Arch Manning was hit from behind and the ball sailed forward.
 What looked like an incomplete pass on third-and-long morphed into a 12-yard gain that led to a game-tying touchdown. After a replay review, officials confirmed the call on the field: a fumble that rolled 18 yards out of Manning’s hand and was recovered by the Longhorns.
